steps.what: Identify the actual food-processing or manufacturing orders, batches, shifts and production exceptions that require the agricultural engineer's supervision in {OPS_SYSTEM}.
inputs: Actual current production orders, batch identifiers and shift context
outputs: Actual selected supervision scope and source records

steps.what: Compile the actual selected batch-status, recorded output, downtime and existing exception fields into the current supervisory view using native {OPS_SYSTEM} filters and joins by the actual order/batch identifiers.
inputs: Actual selected source records from s1
Actual existing timestamped production, downtime and exception records
outputs: Draft current operations view with source timestamps and missing/stale-record flags

steps.what: Read and assess the actual current operations view, checking its timestamps, missing entries and recorded deviations before deciding what needs investigation on the plant floor.
inputs: Draft actual operations view from s2
outputs: Actual supervisory concerns and data gaps requiring direct checks

steps.what: Supervise actual food-processing or manufacturing activity on the plant floor, observing equipment, material flow, hygiene or product conditions and checking the real situation with operators.
inputs: Actual concerns and data gaps from s3
Actual plant equipment, process, product and operators
outputs: Actual observed operating conditions and resolved or unresolved deviations

steps.what: Direct and coordinate the actual plant operators' response to current production needs and deviations, explain priorities and verify their actual response through live supervision.
inputs: Actual production priorities and operator feedback
outputs: Actual coordinated plant supervision and follow-up checks

tasks.design: Replace only an actual manually assembled current-operations view with native filters and exact joins in the existing production system. Preserve source selection, all interpretation, actual floor supervision and direct operator coordination. Existing batch transactions are produced by the plant's normal operator recording and instrument acquisition; those producers continue unchanged. The view makes source age and missing records visible but neither reconstructs unrecorded events nor issues equipment commands. No new shift report, handover note or duplicate supervisory record is imposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: An engineer may copy existing batch, output and downtime fields into a sheet to see the current operating picture.
tasks.enabler_now: Native production-system filters and batch-key joins can supply that exact current view.
tasks.still_hard: A recorded batch state can lag the actual process, and product or equipment conditions still need direct investigation.
tasks.human_edge: Relate actual process behaviour and operator knowledge to the recorded production picture.

ambition.what: Supervise the existing actual plant operations.

tasks.altitude: Define which current operating facts are reliable enough for supervisory use and when floor confirmation is required.

evidence.claim: Native production-system views can compile existing batch records without replacing actual plant supervision or operator capture.

assumptions: Conditional baseline contains actual manual compilation of existing electronic production fields; estimated shares are not a measured plant baseline.

Normal plant operators and instrument interfaces already capture the actual batch, quantity, downtime and exception records. Their existing capture is unchanged, and no saving in that work or new clean feed is assumed.
The machine step performs exact joins and missing/stale-field marking only. Interpretation, investigation and manual resolution of deficient records remain in s3-s5.
If the actual plant already has the view, its existing runtime earns no saving. A paper-only plant would need a separately costed capture project, which is not proposed here.
No actual manual shift report or record write is evidenced beyond the supervisory view; no trailing record or autonomous operating command is added.
unknowns: Whether the engineer actually assembles a sheet today
Actual batch-key consistency and record timeliness
research_questions: Observe an actual supervision round and time view assembly separately from reading, direct checks and operator coordination.
Compare the current batch view with actual floor conditions and identify missing record producers before configuring joins.

already_counted.description: Actual source selection, complete view interpretation, direct plant checks and live operator supervision

incremental.description: Maintain exact batch-key mappings, source-age markers and native view configuration

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative case has paper-only or incompatible batch records, or already supplies the current native view; no new capture duty or manual compilation baseline is added and no change is deployed. In a plant with real manual assembly of compatible existing fields, remove that 10-hour compilation step, less 2 hours upkeep. All interpretation, floor observation and operator direction remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Own the reliability and interpretation of the operating picture while retaining actual floor and operator supervision.
skills_to_grow: Connecting process observations to operating priorities
role.ambitious_version: An engineer who uses a reliable current view to support the same hands-on supervision, without spending time copying production fields.
